title: Israeli Airstrike Hits Hospital in Lebanon, Nine Injured
detail: An Israeli airstrike struck a hospital in Lebanon on May 22, injuring nine people, according to Le Monde's live coverage of the Middle East conflict. The strike represents continued Israeli military action inside Lebanese territory amid ongoing ceasefire fragility. The attack on medical infrastructure drew international attention as humanitarian concerns mount over the targeting of civilian facilities. The ceasefire extended to June 30 remains under pressure as both sides continue hostile actions.

media.caption: Israeli airstrike hits hospital in Lebanon, nine injured — Le Monde live coverage
